messages:
Lina H.: dropping a compact variant for the alerting rule editor — focus: how we surface channel order + suppression in tight card layout (figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-variant). want quick thoughts on copy + keyboard/sr flow. Omar V.: nice density. main worry: overflow chips just show '+N'. that hides whether channels are suppressed vs simply lower priority. can we show '+3 (1 suppressed)' or a small chevron that expands inline? Priya S.: +1 on explicit overflow label. also rename 'Silence window' to 'Quiet hours (suppression window)' to reduce ambiguity for non-ops users. keeps both terms for docs readers. Ben K.: micro UX nit: in compact mode thresholds become icons only. icons aren't enough. suggest a tiny text chip next to channel: e.g. 'CRIT • 95% • 5m' — compact but readable. tooltips as sole source of info = bad for keyboard/sr. a11y-bot: auto-scan results: issues found: 1) small chips contrast 3.2:1 — fails AA for small text. 2) overflow button lacks aria-expanded state. 3) no aria-live region for preview updates. recommendations: raise chip contrast to 4.5:1, add aria-expanded on the overflow toggle, and include
Preview...
. Lina H.: thanks — I'll update chips and overflow label. for preview copy, thinking concise SR-friendly sentence: 'Preview: triggers at 95% for 5m; sends to PagerDuty, then Slack; email suppressed 10pm-6am local.' thoughts? Priya S.: that reads well. add an offscreen id for suppression detail:
Suppressed 10:00 PM 6:00 AM local time.
and reference with aria-describedby from the timeline pill. Omar V.: keyboard order: Threshold input -> Aggregation window -> Preview (aria-live) -> Channel list -> Overflow toggle -> Channel actions. current mock has preview last which breaks the announce flow. can we move preview up so changes announce immediately? Ben K.: add small undo for inline edits: when someone changes threshold show 'Threshold set to 92% — Undo' anchored to preview. make Undo keyboard focusable and give role="alert" so screenreaders get it. Lina H.: will make those changes: 1) explicit overflow with suppressed count, 2) inline microchips for thresholds, 3) preview moved above channels, 4) undo snackbar with role=alert, 5) increased contrast and aria-expanded for overflow. a11y-bot: follow-up: ensure drag handles are focusable (tabindex=0) and have a visible 3px focus ring. also for the timeline pill use pattern+color so colorblind users can tell suppressed ranges. Priya S.: small copy tweak: instead of 'CRIT • 95% • 5m' consider 'CRITICAL 95% (5m)' — slightly longer but clearer on SR reads. Lina, pick which you prefer for the prototype. Lina H.: leaning to 'CRITICAL 95% (5m)' for clarity. will push updated prototype later today and request a quick accessibility pass. thanks all. :thumbsup:
